steps.text: Slaw: cabbage (70/80 g), carrot (50/60 g) and cucumber (60/70 g) — cucumber deseeded and cut into BATONS, not rounds — with lemon, salt and the oil (11/15 g). Leave 5 minutes.
Chicken (95/110 g, from Sunday's roast) sliced thin. DRY pan, high. 2 minutes, then 1½ tsp shawarma spice and 30 seconds more. No oil — you want char, not fry.
Garlic yoghurt: yoghurt (60/80 g), grated garlic, lemon, salt.
Tortilla (45/55 g), 20 seconds a side in the same dry pan until pliable.
Build a LINE down the middle, not across the whole surface: yoghurt, chicken, slaw, shredded cabbage (40/50 g), avocado (25/35 g). Fold the bottom up, then roll tight.

why: Batons, and dress the slaw early. Cucumber rounds go limp and slide out of the far end; batons hold their shape. And five minutes of sitting draws the water out onto the board now rather than into the wrap later.
notes: D0-003: the slaw oil (raw, tossed with lemon/salt, no heat) stays olive_oil — the chicken is explicitly dry-charred, no oil in that pan.

Reviewer FIX (cycle 1), supersedes this rewriter's earlier reading: the build-step lettuce (40/50 g) is now substituted to sweetheart_cabbage. This rewriter had originally held it back because the card text doesn't use the literal word 'shredded' for this ingredient (unlike a-d1l/a-d2l's 'shredded lettuce'). data/raw/shoppinglist.json's sweetheart-cabbage row states the substitution applies 'For every shredded use — the wraps, the bowls' — a source-level ruling that covers this wrap's lettuce categorically, regardless of the card's own wording. Applied per the reviewer's recommendation; the owner can still veto at the a2 batch review. Step 5 text updated to 'shredded cabbage (40/50 g)'.

D0-014 (Sunday cabbage 515 g): this wrap's red_cabbage (70/80 g) is one of the three consumers of Sunday's shred batch — see prep-a.json for the corrected 515 g / three-consumer fix. Note this is a separate ingredient row from the sweetheart_cabbage above: red_cabbage is the Sunday-shredded slaw batch (in the pre-wrap slaw), sweetheart_cabbage is the fresh shredded cabbage built into the wrap itself at plate time.

batchTakeG: chicken 205 g (of the 600 g roast batch) + red cabbage 150 g + carrot 110 g (both from Sunday's shredded-slaw batch). Yoghurt, cucumber, tortilla, sweetheart cabbage and avocado are fresh additions at plate time, not part of the Sunday batch.
